final: SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, p.`First Date`, CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) as age_at_arrival, e.`Examination Date` FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE LOWER(e.Diagnosis) LIKE '%sjs%' ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
